name: voicehire-selenium-tests
description: Selenium E2E tests for the VoiceHire web front end. Isolated from the app: installing here adds nothing to voice_hire_v2, voicehire-backend or mobile.
_notes: Run `npm install` in THIS folder only.
The app must be served first:  cd voice_hire_v2 && npm start   (http://localhost:8080)
Override the target with BASE_URL, e.g. BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm test
Watch the browser with HEADLESS=false npm test
selenium-webdriver 4.x resolves its own driver via Selenium Manager, so no
separate chromedriver download is required as long as Chrome is installed.
